scope: Display-only clarification of publication Figure S3A and Figure 2I. No threshold or numerical figure value is changed.

S3A.matrix: stored processed H5AD X, 45 native marker columns
S3A.selection: exact (File_ID, ID) match to truth.csv, Noise excluded
S3A.formula: count(X_im > 0.0 in group) / count(all cells in group)
S3A.color: mean of all stored values in group, min-max scaled per marker across 27 reference groups

Figure_2I.selection: modal method prediction across four raw LLMs equals CD8+ T; ties GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek
Figure_2I.formula: 100 * count(X_im > 0.0 in selected method group) / selected group count
Figure_2I.additional_expression_transform_before_t: none (Scanpy log=False, no raw/layer in constructed AnnData)
Figure_2I.color: mean of all stored values in each selected group, min-max scaled per marker across four method groups

Figure_2I.independent_master_reexecution_this_revi: not performed; local master.csv is an iCloud dataless placeholder. Definition verified from actual producer and existing audit.

upstream_transform_history: Not encoded in source H5AD uns, raw or layers and not independently reconstructed in this revision. Do not call these values raw fluorescence intensities.
biological_marker_positivity_validation: Not established for these cutoffs. These are operational above-threshold fractions.

def _h5ad_truth_expression(truth: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[np.ndarray, list[str], pd.DataFrame, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Load the exact eight-FOV raw matrix directly from the traced H5AD.

    The source data contain 64 FOVs.  The B004 truth universe is eight full
    FOV blocks, so this reads seven contiguous HDF5 ranges instead of using a
    slow discontinuous fancy index.  The result still fail-closes on exact
    ``(File_ID, ID)`` equality with ``truth.csv``.
    """

    target_fids = sorted(truth["File_ID"].unique().tolist())
    with h5py.File(_require(H5AD), "r") as handle:
        markers = [_decode_h5(value) for value in handle["var"]["_index"][:]]
        if len(markers) != 45 or len(markers) != len(set(markers)):
            raise SupplementaryFigureS01ReplayError(
                f"H5AD marker contract changed: expected 45 unique markers, found {len(markers)}"
            )
        categories = [_decode_h5(value) for value in handle["obs"]["File_ID"]["categories"][:]]
        code_by_fid = {value: index for index, value in enumerate(categories)}
        missing_fids = sorted(set(target_fids).difference(code_by_fid))
        if missing_fids:
            raise SupplementaryFigureS01ReplayError(f"H5AD lacks truth File_ID values {missing_fids}")
        codes = handle["obs"]["File_ID"]["codes"][:]
        selected = np.flatnonzero(np.isin(codes, [code_by_fid[value] for value in target_fids]))
        if len(selected) != EXPECTED_CELLS:
            raise SupplementaryFigureS01ReplayError(
                f"H5AD B004 FOV selection has {len(selected):,} rows, expected {EXPECTED_CELLS:,}"
            )
        breaks = np.flatnonzero(np.diff(selected) > 1) + 1
        starts = np.r_[0, breaks]
        ends = np.r_[breaks - 1, len(selected) - 1]
        x_parts: list[np.ndarray] = []
        id_parts: list[np.ndarray] = []
        code_parts: list[np.ndarray] = []
        for start, end in zip(starts, ends, strict=True):
            first = int(selected[int(start)])
            last = int(selected[int(end)]) + 1
            x_parts.append(np.asarray(handle["X"][first:last, :], dtype=np.float32))
            id_parts.append(np.asarray(handle["obs"]["ID"][first:last], dtype=np.int64))
            code_parts.append(np.asarray(codes[first:last]))

    expression = np.vstack(x_parts)
    source_ids = np.concatenate(id_parts)
    source_codes = np.concatenate(code_parts)
    source_fids = np.asarray([categories[int(code)] for code in source_codes], dtype=object)
    h5_keys = pd.DataFrame({"File_ID": source_fids.astype(str), "ID": source_ids.astype(str)})
    if h5_keys.duplicated(list(KEYS)).any():
        raise SupplementaryFigureS01ReplayError("H5AD B004 block has duplicate exact keys")
    _assert_same_keys(truth, h5_keys, left_label="truth.csv", right_label="source H5AD")
    source = h5_keys.copy()
    source["_row"] = np.arange(len(source), dtype=int)
    ordered = truth[list(KEYS)].merge(source, on=list(KEYS), how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
    if len(ordered) != EXPECTED_CELLS:
        raise SupplementaryFigureS01ReplayError("Unable to preserve truth order for H5AD expression matrix")
    expression = expression[ordered["_row"].to_numpy(dtype=int)]
    return expression, markers, truth.copy(), {
        "input": _artifact_facts(H5AD),
        "matrix_shape": [int(expression.shape[0]), int(expression.shape[1])],
        "markers": markers,
        "contiguous_h5ad_ranges": int(len(starts)),
        "exact_key_match": True,
    }

def render_panel_a() -> dict[str, Path]:
    """Replay ``dotplot_truth.py`` from H5AD raw truth data at final size."""

    trace = _source_trace()
    truth = _read_truth()
    expression, markers, ordered_truth, h5_facts = _h5ad_truth_expression(truth)
    non_noise = ordered_truth["raw_label"].ne("Noise").to_numpy()
    labels = ordered_truth.loc[non_noise, "raw_label"].astype(str).to_numpy()
    x = expression[non_noise]
    if len(x) != 209_587:
        raise SupplementaryFigureS01ReplayError(
            f"Panel A non-Noise source universe changed to {len(x):,} cells"
        )
    source_means = pd.DataFrame(x, columns=markers).groupby(labels, sort=True).mean()
    row_order = _correlation_leaf_order(source_means.to_numpy(), "cell-type")
    col_order = _correlation_leaf_order(source_means.to_numpy().T, "marker")
    labels_ordered = source_means.index.to_numpy()[row_order].astype(str).tolist()
    markers_ordered = source_means.columns.to_numpy()[col_order].astype(str).tolist()
    means = source_means.loc[labels_ordered, markers_ordered]
    fractions = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            label: (x[labels == label] > PANEL_A_EXPRESSION_CUTOFF).mean(axis=0)
            for label in labels_ordered
        },
        index=markers,
    ).T.loc[labels_ordered, markers_ordered]
    low = means.min(axis=0)
    span = (means.max(axis=0) - low).replace(0, 1.0)
    scaled = (means - low) / span

    png, pdf, _ = _panel_paths("A")
    width, height = PANEL_FOOTPRINTS["A"]
    with matplotlib.rc_context(_font_rc()):
        fig = plt.figure(figsize=(width, height), dpi=DPI, facecolor="white")
        add_panel_label(fig, 0.006, 0.993, "A", ha="left", va="top")
        fig.text(
            0.055,
            0.993,
            "Ground-truth protein expression",
            fontsize=FONT_SIZE_PT,
            fontname=FONT_FAMILY,
            ha="left",
            va="top",
        )
        # The long raw label ``CD49a+ Smooth muscle`` is the limiting left
        # extent.  Leave it a full 0.275 of the panel width so the source
        # vocabulary remains visible rather than silently abbreviating it.
        ax = fig.add_axes((0.275, 0.205, 0.515, 0.735))
        row_index = np.repeat(np.arange(len(labels_ordered)), len(markers_ordered))
        col_index = np.tile(np.arange(len(markers_ordered)), len(labels_ordered))
        dot_values = scaled.to_numpy().ravel()
        dot_fractions = fractions.to_numpy().ravel()
        # Keep the fraction encoding but cap dots below the fixed marker pitch
        # at the publication footprint, preventing overlap in the dense grid.
        sizes = 1.0 + 5.0 * dot_fractions
        scatter = ax.scatter(
            col_index,
            row_index,
            s=sizes,
            c=dot_values,
            cmap="Reds",
            norm=Normalize(vmin=0, vmax=1),
            marker="o",
            linewidths=0,
            rasterized=True,
        )
        ax.set_xlim(-0.55, len(markers_ordered) - 0.45)
        ax.set_ylim(len(labels_ordered) - 0.45, -0.55)
        ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(markers_ordered)))
        # All markers remain plotted; label every third marker at 5 pt so the
        # visible protein-marker ticker labels are readable rather than colliding.
        ax.set_xticklabels(
            [marker if index % 3 == 0 else "" for index, marker in enumerate(markers_ordered)],
            rotation=90,
            ha="center",
            va="top",
            fontsize=FONT_SIZE_PT,
        )
        ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(labels_ordered)))
        ax.set_yticklabels(labels_ordered, fontsize=FONT_SIZE_PT)
        ax.tick_params(axis="x", length=0, pad=0.4, colors="black")
        ax.tick_params(axis="y", length=0, pad=0.8, colors="black")
        for spine in ax.spines.values():
            spine.set_visible(False)
        # Keep the scale next to the dot grid, using a vertical label that
        # reads bottom-to-top instead of a horizontal heading across dots.
        cax = fig.add_axes((0.815, 0.585, 0.025, 0.245))
        colorbar = fig.colorbar(scatter, cax=cax)
        colorbar.set_ticks([0, 1])
        colorbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=FONT_SIZE_PT, length=1.2, width=0.3, colors="black", pad=0.4)
        colorbar.set_label(
            "Scaled mean expression",
            fontsize=FONT_SIZE_PT,
            color="black",
            rotation=90,
            labelpad=1.0,
        )
        sax = fig.add_axes((0.803, 0.270, 0.180, 0.195))
        sax.set_xlim(0, 1)
        sax.set_ylim(0, 1)
        sax.axis("off")
        # Swap the descriptive vertical label with the numeric key labels so
        # the size values sit at the left and the label reads bottom-to-top at
        # the right, with the dots retained between them.
        sax.text(0.40, 0.56, f"Fraction with processed X > {PANEL_A_EXPRESSION_CUTOFF:g} (%)", fontsize=FONT_SIZE_PT, va="center", ha="center", rotation=90)
        for fraction, y in ((0.25, 0.56), (0.50, 0.35), (0.75, 0.14)):
            sax.scatter(0.19, y, s=1.0 + 5.0 * fraction, color="#c9c9c9", linewidths=0)
            sax.text(0.03, y, f"{int(fraction * 100)}", fontsize=FONT_SIZE_PT, va="center", ha="center")
        _save_figure(fig, png, pdf)

    audit = _write_panel_audit(
        "A",
        {
            "source_status": trace["panels"]["A"]["status"],
            "historical_root_producers": _root_source_facts("A"),
            "render_mode": "source-style H5AD raw-truth dotplot",
            "data_semantics": "raw cell_type_update; Noise excluded as in dotplot_truth.py; no clusters and no LLM input",
            "h5ad_input": h5_facts,
            "row_order": labels_ordered,
            "marker_order": markers_ordered,
            "color_scale": "Reds sequential, per-marker standard scale 0-1",
            "size_encoding": f"fraction of cells with stored processed X > {PANEL_A_EXPRESSION_CUTOFF:g}",
            "expression_cutoff": PANEL_A_EXPRESSION_CUTOFF,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "expression_transform": "none at dot-plot stage; stored processed H5AD X",
            "biological_positivity_validation": "not established",
        },
    )
    return {"png": png, "pdf": pdf, "audit": audit}

def _panel_i_expression_input(base: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, list[str]]:
    """Load the exact historical 45-marker matrix from master.csv.

    ``master.csv`` has the same 45 H5AD marker values used by the historical
    dotplot, keyed to the frozen 220,082-cell subset.  The marker order is
    recovered from the historical H5AD rather than assumed from CSV order.
    """
    markers = _h5ad_marker_names()
    master = pd.read_csv(_require(MASTER_CSV), usecols=[*KEYS, *markers])
    master = _standardize_keys(master, "master.csv 45-marker matrix")
    missing_markers = sorted(set(markers).difference(master.columns))
    if missing_markers:
        raise HistoricalIJReplayInputError(f"master.csv lacks H5AD markers {missing_markers}")
    frame = master.merge(base, on=list(KEYS), how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
    if len(frame) != EXPECTED_CELLS:
        raise HistoricalIJReplayInputError(
            f"master/optimized-V3 exact-key intersection has {len(frame):,} cells; expected {EXPECTED_CELLS:,}"
        )
    if frame[markers].isna().any().any():
        raise HistoricalIJReplayInputError("master.csv marker matrix contains null values")
    return frame, markers

def render_panel_i(output_dir: Path = OUTPUT_DIR) -> dict[str, Path]:
    """Render the V1 four-method dotplot using all four LLMs per method."""
    _activate_optimized_registry()
    import anndata as ad
    import matplotlib

    matplotlib.use("Agg", force=True)
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    import scanpy as sc

    output_dir = Path(output_dir).resolve()
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    trace_path = write_source_trace(output_dir)
    base, tie_counts = _v3_method_consensus(_load_base())
    frame, markers = _panel_i_expression_input(base)
    display_markers, marker_abbreviation_map = _panel_i_display_markers(markers)

    parts: list[ad.AnnData] = []
    group_order: list[str] = []
    source_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for method in METHOD_ORDER:
        source = f"{method}_label"
        group = METHOD_DISPLAY[method]
        mask = frame[source].astype(str).eq(TARGET_CELL_TYPE)
        n_selected = int(mask.sum())
        if not n_selected:
            raise HistoricalIJReplayInputError(f"{source} predicts no {TARGET_CELL_TYPE} cells")
        values = frame.loc[mask, markers].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32, copy=True)
        part = ad.AnnData(X=values)
        part.var_names = markers
        part.obs["method_llm"] = group
        part.obs_names = [f"{source}_{index}" for index in range(n_selected)]
        parts.append(part)
        group_order.append(group)
        source_counts[source] = n_selected

    combined = ad.concat(parts, merge="same")
    combined.obs["method_llm"] = pd.Categorical(
        combined.obs["method_llm"], categories=group_order, ordered=True
    )
    # Preserve both the full 45-column expression matrix and the original V1
    # marker strings, rather than abbreviating source-visible text.
    combined.var_names = display_markers
    png_path = output_dir / "figure_02i_v1_scanpy_dotplot_v3_4llm_consensus.png"
    pdf_path = output_dir / "figure_02i_v1_scanpy_dotplot_v3_4llm_consensus.pdf"
    with matplotlib.rc_context(_font_rc()):
        dotplot = sc.pl.dotplot(
            combined,
            var_names=display_markers,
            groupby="method_llm",
            standard_scale="var",
            expression_cutoff=PANEL_I_EXPRESSION_CUTOFF,
            use_raw=False,
            log=False,
            mean_only_expressed=False,
            swap_axes=False,
            # This is the original four-method source geometry at its native
            # compact-page footprint; no later compositor scales 5-pt text.
            figsize=PANEL_I_FOOTPRINT_IN,
            show=False,
            return_fig=True,
        )
        # The default 200-point source dots are appropriate for the original
        # 12.5-inch script canvas but overlap at this compact native panel.
        # A 14-point cap is smaller than the 45-marker x spacing while
        # preserving the fraction-of-cells size encoding.
        dotplot.style(cmap="Reds", largest_dot=14.0)
        axes = dotplot.get_axes()
        main = axes["mainplot_ax"]
        main.set_title("")
        # Make the two categorical axes explicit in the final compact panel.
        # The native 1.35-inch footprint below reserves a dedicated bottom
        # band, so the label does not compete with the 45 vertical marker
        # tick labels.
        main.set_xlabel("")
        # The marker axis uses the full native width, retaining every marker at
        # 5 pt without reducing the font or discarding labels.
        main.set_ylabel("Clustering method", fontsize=5, fontname="Arial", color="black", labelpad=4.0)
        main.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=5, pad=0)
        main.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=5, pad=1)
        main.tick_params(axis="y", labelleft=False)
        for label in main.get_xticklabels():
            label.set_rotation(90)
            label.set_horizontalalignment("center")
            label.set_verticalalignment("top")
        # Preserve the source's right-side legend arrangement.  The main panel
        # receives a fixed native 5-point marker footprint while the original
        # Scanpy size and expression legend axes remain visible at right.
        # Give all 45 five-point vertical marker labels the full native panel
        # width.  Legends move into the otherwise unused lower band so marker
        # names and dots do not collide.
        # Reserve a genuine, in-bounds header band for both legends.  The
        # prior layout put their titles against the raster edge, clipping the
        # fraction label and hiding the mean-expression label in the packet.
        # The plot is lifted into the enlarged native footprint so the
        # Protein marker axis label remains fully in-bounds below the rotated
        # marker names.
        # The widened native panel gives every rotated marker label a little
        # more horizontal room without reducing its five-point typography.
        main.set_position([0.18, 0.460, 0.815, 0.235])
        main.set_yticklabels(group_order, fontname="Arial", fontsize=5, color="black")
        main.tick_params(axis="y", labelleft=True)
        size_ax = axes.get("size_legend_ax")
        color_ax = axes.get("color_legend_ax")
        if size_ax is not None:
            size_ax.set_visible(False)
        if color_ax is not None:
            color_ax.set_visible(False)
        fig = plt.gcf()
        fig.text(0.600, 0.012, "Protein marker", fontsize=5, fontname="Arial", color="black", ha="center", va="bottom")
        # Scanpy's source legend is far larger than the panel at a 5-point
        # final footprint.  Rebuild the same encodings in a compact lower
        # strip rather than allowing its labels to collide with marker names.
        legend_ax = fig.add_axes([0.15, 0.735, 0.39, 0.170])
        # Keep the heading in the header band; move every size key circle and
        # its number down as one group so the 50% marker cannot touch it.
        legend_ax.scatter([0.16, 0.50, 0.84], [0.36] * 3, s=[8.0, 22.0, 45.0], c="#808080", edgecolors="black", linewidths=0.3)
        for x, label in zip([0.16, 0.50, 0.84], ["0", "50", "100"], strict=True):
            legend_ax.text(x, -0.18, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=5, fontname="Arial", color="black", clip_on=False)
        legend_ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
        legend_ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
        legend_ax.axis("off")
        colorbar_ax = fig.add_axes([0.66, 0.775, 0.25, 0.035])
        scalar = matplotlib.cm.ScalarMappable(norm=matplotlib.colors.Normalize(0, 1), cmap="Reds")
        colorbar = fig.colorbar(scalar, cax=colorbar_ax, orientation="horizontal", ticks=[0, 1])
        colorbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=5, pad=0.2, length=1.2, width=0.3, colors="black")
        # Both legend headings share one visual baseline above their encodings.
        fig.text(0.345, 0.910, f"Fraction with processed X > {PANEL_I_EXPRESSION_CUTOFF:g} (%)", fontsize=5, fontname="Arial", color="black", ha="center", va="top")
        fig.text(0.785, 0.910, "Scaled mean expression", fontsize=5, fontname="Arial", color="black", ha="center", va="top")
        _set_black_arial_text(axes.values())
        fig.set_size_inches(*PANEL_I_FOOTPRINT_IN, forward=True)
        add_panel_label(fig, 0.002, 0.997, "I", ha="left", va="top")
        fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=600, facecolor="white", bbox_inches=None)
        fig.savefig(pdf_path, dpi=600, facecolor="white", bbox_inches=None)
        plt.close(fig)

    audit = {
        "schema_version": "cell_masks.figure_02.panel_i.v3_source_replay.v2",
        "historical_source": str(HISTORICAL_PANEL_I_SCRIPT),
        "historical_source_sha256": _sha256(HISTORICAL_PANEL_I_SCRIPT),
        "source_trace": str(trace_path),
        "v3_source_labels": "all 16 frozen optimized-V3 raw method×LLM columns, reduced within method by deterministic four-LLM modal raw label",
        "prediction_rule": (
            f"modal raw method label equals {TARGET_CELL_TYPE!r}; ties use GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek order; "
            "no post-hoc selector label is used"
        ),
        "n_input_cells": EXPECTED_CELLS,
        "n_marker_features": len(markers),
        "expression_cutoff": PANEL_I_EXPRESSION_CUTOFF,
        "threshold_operator": ">",
        "expression_transform": "none at dot-plot stage; stored processed master.csv values in AnnData X",
        "biological_positivity_validation": "not established",
        "markers": markers,
        "marker_display_labels": marker_abbreviation_map,
        "marker_display_rule": (
            "all 45 historical marker columns are retained in H5AD order and displayed verbatim "
            "on the visible x-axis at the fixed 5-point footprint"
        ),
        "legend_layout": {
            "size": "source Scanpy dot-size legend retained at the right of the dotplot",
            "color": "source red mean-expression legend retained at the lower right of the dotplot",
            "reason": (
                "the compact V3 revision moves both legends below the dotplot, freeing the full width for "
                "45 non-overlapping 5-point marker labels without compositor scaling"
            ),
        },
        "source_selected_cell_counts": source_counts,
        "method_modal_tie_counts": tie_counts,
        "display_groups": group_order,
        "metric_boundary": (
            "qualitative marker-expression display; it is not a phase7-plus-source "
            "post-hoc exact-cell selector accuracy panel"
        ),
        "final_footprint_inches": list(PANEL_I_FOOTPRINT_IN),
        "font_contract": "All non-panel-label text is black Arial 5 pt at final exported footprint.",
        "panel_label_contract": panel_label_contract("I"),
        "source_sha256": {
            "optimized_v3_raw_sources": _sha256(OPTIMIZED_ANNOTATIONS),
            "master_marker_matrix": _sha256(MASTER_CSV),
            "historical_h5ad_marker_order": _sha256(H5AD),
        },
        "outputs": {"png": str(png_path), "pdf": str(pdf_path)},
    }
    audit_path = output_dir / "figure_02i_v1_scanpy_dotplot_v3_4llm_consensus.audit.json"
    audit_path.write_text(json.dumps(audit, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return {"png": png_path, "pdf": pdf_path, "audit": audit_path}
